cohort: A cohort of 7 pregnant women aged 20-35 years diagnosed with adnexal masses during routine antenatal ultrasound.
finding: Most adnexal masses in pregnancy are benign and can be managed expectantly if asymptomatic, with all 7 cases in this study successfully managed by caesarean section and cystectomy, leading to uneventful postoperative periods and no maternal or neonatal complications.
mod_finding: All 7 cases in the study had a caesarean section along with cystectomy.
